agent.desc: Conduct rules and memory management. Conduct rules are injected into every conversation's system prompt and all agents must follow them.
arbiter.title: Arbiter mode
arbiter.desc: How a new message is handled while the conversation is running: queue it / let the judge merge or queue automatically / queue and ask whether to handle it first.
conduct.title: Global conduct rules
conduct.desc: Applies to all agents, e.g.: answer concisely, no emoji, confirm before changing code.
conduct.placeholder: Write a rule every agent should follow…
conduct.saveFailed: Failed to save global conduct rules: {{message}}
style.title: Speaking style
style.desc: A global tone overlay spliced into every conversation's system prompt, stacked on top of each agent's own temperament.
style.loadFailedOption: Failed to read; refresh and retry
style.saved: Speaking style saved; applies from the next conversation turn
guidelines.title: Per-agent conduct rules
guidelines.desc: Applies only to the selected agent, layered on top of the global rules.
rounds.title: Round limits
rounds.desc: Global caps on ReAct reasoning turns and tool-call counts. Read on every conversation turn and dispatched task; changes apply to the next chat turn / task.
rounds.invalidRange: {{label}} must be an integer between 1 and {{max}}
rounds.saved: {{label}} saved; applies to the next chat turn / task
quota.title: Daily token quota
quota.desc: Cap on the combined input + output tokens of all LLM calls within the UTC calendar day; 0 = unlimited. After saving, the new quota applies from the next chat turn; usage keeps accumulating across service restarts.
quota.invalid: The daily token quota must be an integer between 0 and {{max}} (0 = unlimited)
quota.saved: Daily token quota saved; the new quota applies from the next chat turn
quota.saveFailed: Failed to save the daily token quota: {{message}}
network.title: Network permissions
network.desc: Controls the agent's network access tier; applies at the next network check, no restart needed.
network.domainsLabel: Whitelist domains (one per line, e.g. github.com):
network.modeSaved: Network permissions saved; applies at the next network check
network.invalidDomain: "{{line}}" is not a domain: one host per line (e.g. github.com), no protocol or path
network.domainsSaved: Whitelist saved ({{count}} domains); applies at the next network check
workspace.title: Working directory
workspace.desc: Relative to the repo root, default workspace; shared with the resource library. Restart the dev service after saving to switch.
workspace.invalidPath: The working directory must not contain ".." segments
workspace.saved: Saved. After restarting the dev service, file tools and the resource library will use the new directory.
workspace.saveFailed: Failed to save the working directory: {{message}}
fsroots.invalidPath: "{{line}}" is not an absolute path: one absolute path per line (e.g. D:\docs or /home/me/docs), no ".." segments
readRoots.title: Additional read-only directories
readRoots.desc: Read-only whitelist outside the working directory: read_file / list_dir can access these directories; writes and deletes remain limited to the working directory. Saving applies at the next file-read check, no restart needed.
readRoots.cleared: Additional read-only directories cleared; applies at the next file-read check
readRoots.saved: Saved; applies at the next file-read check
readRoots.saveFailed: Failed to save additional read-only directories: {{message}}
writeRoots.title: Additional read-write directories
writeRoots.desc: Writable whitelist outside the working directory: reads inside are direct; writes and deletes require user L2 confirmation (writes inside the workspace are L1 with a notice — this is stricter). Saving applies at the next file-permission check, no restart needed.
writeRoots.cleared: Additional read-write directories cleared; applies at the next file-permission check
writeRoots.saved: Saved; applies at the next file-permission check
writeRoots.saveFailed: Failed to save additional read-write directories: {{message}}
appPolicy.title: In-app capabilities
appPolicy.desc: Controls whether the agent can call in-app capabilities such as notes and the graph. Names match the tool surface on the team page (e.g. notes__create_note). A lone * on its own line means all in-app capabilities; notes__* means the domain prefix; deny takes precedence over allow. An empty allow list makes bridge tools like notes/graph all fail. Approved external MCP servers (mcp__*) also go through this list; files, network, and commands do not.
appPolicy.emptyNotAllowed: {{label}} must not be empty; keep at least * or one concrete capability name
appPolicy.saved: {{label}} saved; applies at the next capability call
appPolicy.errSeparator: "{{line}}" contains path or protocol separators; only capability names are allowed
appPolicy.errInvalidName: "{{line}}" is not a valid capability name
skills.title: Skills
skills.desc: Reusable procedure packages. The index (name + one-line description) stays resident in conversation context; when steps are needed the agent fetches the full text with load_skill.
skills.empty: No skills yet. Put SKILL.md under skills/<name>/ in the working directory; it takes effect after restarting the dev service.
mcp.title: External MCP
mcp.desc: After adding, its tools are listed first and only approval puts them on the conversation tool surface; domain notes/graph still go through built-in capabilities — do not enter this repo's mcp_server here.
mcp.empty: No external MCP servers yet. Use the form below to add a stdio command or HTTP URL.
mcp.list.refreshFailed: Failed to refresh the tool list: {{message}}
mcp.list.approvedToast: Approved {{count}} tools into the roster; if this conversation turn already started, they become visible in the next turn or a new conversation
mcp.list.removedToast: Removed MCP "{{id}}"; its tools have been taken off the roster
mcp.list.removeConfirm: This disconnects the server, takes its tools off the roster, and deletes the configuration. Remove it?
mcp.form.heading: Add external MCP
mcp.form.invalidId: The id must be 1–32 lowercase letters/digits/hyphens starting with a letter
mcp.form.addedConnected: MCP "{{id}}" added and tools listed; after approval they enter the tool roster, visible next turn or in a new conversation
mcp.form.addedDisconnected: MCP "{{id}}" saved, but the connection failed: {{error}}. Once fixed, use "Refresh tool list"

hooks.title: User hooks
hooks.desc: Declarative hooks under hooks/ in the working directory (JSON files, on + enabled). After adding/editing/removing files, click "Reload" for immediate effect — no dev-service restart needed; hooks from approved plugins are unaffected.
hooks.empty: No user hooks yet. Put JSON files under hooks/ in the working directory (e.g. {{example}}), then click "Reload" above.
memory.title: Memory
memory.desc: The agent's four memory kinds. The profile summary is injected into every conversation's system prompt; clearing only affects memory — the conversation timeline, notes, and projects are kept.
memory.loadFailed: Failed to load the memory snapshot; the style and conduct rules above are unaffected. Please refresh and retry.
memory.refreshFailed: Failed to refresh the memory snapshot: {{message}}
memory.loadFailedToast: Failed to load the memory snapshot: {{message}}
memory.workingMeta: Currently {{count}} items · in-process, empty after restart
memory.confirm.all: Clear all of the agent's memory (user profile, episodic, semantic, working)? The conversation timeline, notes, and projects are kept. This cannot be undone.
memory.confirm.profile: Clear the user profile? The agent will forget your preferences and background. The conversation timeline, notes, and projects are kept. This cannot be undone.
memory.confirm.episodic: Clear episodic memory (decision and event trail)? The conversation timeline, notes, and projects are kept. This cannot be undone.
memory.confirm.semantic: Clear semantic memory (fact triples)? The conversation timeline, notes, and projects are kept. This cannot be undone.
retention.title: Episodic retention days
retention.desc: 0 = no automatic daily clearing (managed by the agent); > 0 = when this page opens, episodes older than the set days are cleared.
retention.invalid: Retention days must be an integer between 0 and {{max}}; 0 means managed by the agent
retention.savedDays: Episodic memory kept for {{days}} days; older episodes are cleared when this page opens
retention.savedManaged: Managed by the agent; no more daily clearing
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.desc: Declarative plugins under plugins/ at the repo root. Bundle approval mounts their skills and hooks into the system; you can also expand and pick per item. MCP configs shipped with a plugin are only registered as pending entries — tools still need per-server approval under External MCP. Unapproving also removes its registered external MCP servers whose tools were never approved (servers with approved tools are kept).
plugins.empty: No plugins discovered yet. Drop a plugin directory containing plugin.json into plugins/ at the repo root and it will show up here; you can also install from a zip or a local directory via the install entry above.
plugins.approved: Approved plugin "{{name}}": {{skills}} skills and {{hooks}} hooks mounted
plugins.mcpRegistered: ; {{count}} MCP configs registered; tools still need approval under "External MCP"
plugins.skippedItems: ; {{count}} picked items no longer exist in the plugin and were skipped (picks are kept and apply once restored)
plugins.revoked: Revoked plugin "{{name}}"; its skills and hooks have been removed from the system
plugins.revokedMcpReclaimed: ; also removed its external MCP servers: {{list}}
plugins.overwriteConfirm: An overwrite install first deletes the same-named plugin directory before installing the new content. Overwrite?
plugins.installed: Installed plugin "{{name}}"{{version}}, not yet approved; it mounts only after approval below
plugins.deleteConfirm: Delete plugin "{{name}}" (directory {{path}})? This cannot be undone.
plugins.revokeNote: Revoking will also remove its registered external MCP servers: {{list}}.
plugins.revokeConfirm: Revoke approval of "{{name}}"? Its skills and hooks will unmount immediately. {{note}}
plugins.dirPlaceholder: or paste an absolute path to a local plugin directory (must be inside the working directory or additional roots)
plugins.overwriteNote: Same-named plugins are not overwritten by default; an approved same-named plugin is never overwritten — revoke its approval first.
plugins.mcpNote: Checking an MCP only registers it as a pending entry; tools still need approval under External MCP.
plugins.pickRequired: Pick at least one item (skills / hooks / MCP).
